_readme: Every event Orbit DECLARES in a schema, and what proves it actually fires.
The rule this file enforces: a registered listener is not a working event.
Nine existing tests assert only that addListener() did not throw, and
action.onClicked, tabs.onReplaced and webNavigation.onTabReplaced are all
declared, all registerable, and none of them is ever dispatched. A schema
diff cannot see this -- the member IS present -- so it needs its own table.
OrbitTests/ExtensionEventLivenessCoverageTests.swift (host-less) asserts that
this table covers exactly the events Orbit declares, and that every
notDispatched entry is also recorded in ExpectedAPIGaps.json.
OrbitAppTests/ChromiumExtensionEventLivenessLiveTests.swift (live) loads one
MV3 fixture that listens to all of them, performs each `cause` against a real
engine, and evaluates each `payload` predicate against the arguments the
listener was actually handed.
payload is a JavaScript expression over `args`, the real argument list. It
must assert SHAPE, not arrival: tabs.onCreated was dispatched with the wrong
argument list entirely (section 8.1), which any invocation count would have
passed. That is why the coverage test rejects a payload without a typeof.
status:
observed       a live test causes it and asserts its payload
notDispatched  declared and never fired; must also appear in
ExpectedAPIGaps.json's neverDispatchedEvents
blocked        cannot be caused from a test host; requires blockedBy
cause names the step the live suite performs. An unknown cause fails that
suite by name rather than being silently skipped.

action.onClicked.why: Declared in Chromium/Embedder/common/api/action.json and fired by nothing in Orbit. The Swift side knows and refuses to draw a toolbar icon for a popup-less action at all, so every extension whose button is a click handler rather than a popup is invisible and inert.

bookmarks.onCreated.payload: args.length >= 2 && typeof args[0] === 'string' && typeof args[1] === 'object' && args[1] !== null && typeof args[1].id === 'string' && args[1].id === args[0] && typeof args[1].title === 'string' && typeof args[1].parentId === 'string' && typeof args[1].index === 'number'
bookmarks.onCreated.why: Nothing in Orbit calls this directly: orbit_bookmark_registry.cc diffs one pushed tree against the last, so the cause is a real sidebar mutation, not an API call.

bookmarks.onChanged.payload: args.length >= 2 && typeof args[0] === 'string' && typeof args[1] === 'object' && args[1] !== null && typeof args[1].title === 'string' && args[1].title.length > 0

bookmarks.onMoved.payload: args.length >= 2 && typeof args[0] === 'string' && typeof args[1] === 'object' && args[1] !== null && typeof args[1].parentId === 'string' && typeof args[1].index === 'number' && typeof args[1].oldParentId === 'string' && typeof args[1].oldIndex === 'number' && args[1].parentId !== args[1].oldParentId

bookmarks.onRemoved.payload: args.length >= 2 && typeof args[0] === 'string' && typeof args[1] === 'object' && args[1] !== null && typeof args[1].parentId === 'string' && typeof args[1].index === 'number' && typeof args[1].node === 'object' && args[1].node !== null && typeof args[1].node.id === 'string' && args[1].node.parentId === undefined

commands.onCommand.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'string' && args[0] === 'orbit-liveness-command' && (args[1] === undefined || (typeof args[1] === 'object' && args[1] !== null && typeof args[1].id === 'number'))

contextMenus.onClicked.payload: args.length >= 2 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].menuItemId === 'string' && args[0].menuItemId === 'orbit-liveness-menu-item' && typeof args[0].pageUrl === 'string' && typeof args[0].editable === 'boolean' && typeof args[1] === 'object' && args[1] !== null && typeof args[1].id === 'number'

cookies.onChanged.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].removed === 'boolean' && typeof args[0].cause === 'string' && typeof args[0].cookie === 'object' && typeof args[0].cookie.name === 'string' && typeof args[0].cookie.domain === 'string'

downloads.onCreated.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].id === 'number' && typeof args[0].url === 'string' && typeof args[0].filename === 'string' && typeof args[0].state === 'string' && typeof args[0].startTime === 'string'

downloads.onChanged.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].id === 'number' && typeof args[0].state === 'object' && args[0].state !== null && typeof args[0].state.current === 'string' && args[0].bytesReceived === undefined
downloads.onChanged.why: The delta must carry no bytesReceived: including it would fire this event on every packet, which is why the shape assertion names its absence.

history.onVisited.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].id === 'string' && typeof args[0].url === 'string' && typeof args[0].title === 'string' && typeof args[0].lastVisitTime === 'number' && typeof args[0].visitCount === 'number' && typeof args[0].typedCount === 'number'
history.onVisited.why: Caused through AppEnvironment.recordVisit, the funnel every Orbit navigation passes through. An addUrl-only onVisited would tell an extension nothing about the browsing it exists to watch.

history.onVisitRemoved.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].allHistory === 'boolean' && args[0].allHistory === false && Array.isArray(args[0].urls) && args[0].urls.length > 0 && typeof args[0].urls[0] === 'string'

permissions.onAdded.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && Array.isArray(args[0].permissions) && args[0].permissions.indexOf('privacy') !== -1

permissions.onRemoved.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && Array.isArray(args[0].permissions) && args[0].permissions.indexOf('privacy') !== -1

sessions.onChanged.why: The schema declares no parameters, so the shape assertion is that the argument list really is empty: a listener handed anything here would be reading a value orbit_session_service.cc never sends.

tabs.onCreated.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].id === 'number' && typeof args[0].windowId === 'number' && typeof args[0].index === 'number'
tabs.onCreated.why: This event was dispatched with the wrong argument list -- the payload assertion, not the invocation count, is what catches that.

tabs.onUpdated.payload: args.length >= 3 && typeof args[0] === 'number' && typeof args[1] === 'object' && args[1] !== null && typeof args[2] === 'object' && args[2] !== null && typeof args[2].id === 'number' && args[2].id === args[0]

tabs.onMoved.payload: args.length >= 2 && typeof args[0] === 'number' && typeof args[1] === 'object' && args[1] !== null && typeof args[1].windowId === 'number' && typeof args[1].fromIndex === 'number' && typeof args[1].toIndex === 'number'

tabs.onActivated.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].tabId === 'number' && typeof args[0].windowId === 'number'

tabs.onRemoved.payload: args.length >= 2 && typeof args[0] === 'number' && typeof args[1] === 'object' && args[1] !== null && typeof args[1].windowId === 'number' && typeof args[1].isWindowClosing === 'boolean'

tabs.onReplaced.why: orbit_tab_registry.cc fires onCreated, onUpdated, onRemoved, onActivated and onMoved and nothing else. Declared here so that the day prerendering or a back/forward-cache activation starts swapping tabs, this entry is what has to change.

webNavigation.onBeforeNavigate.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].tabId === 'number' && typeof args[0].url === 'string' && typeof args[0].frameId === 'number' && typeof args[0].timeStamp === 'number'

webNavigation.onCommitted.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].tabId === 'number' && typeof args[0].url === 'string' && typeof args[0].transitionType === 'string'

webNavigation.onDOMContentLoaded.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].tabId === 'number' && typeof args[0].url === 'string' && typeof args[0].frameId === 'number'

webNavigation.onCompleted.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].tabId === 'number' && typeof args[0].url === 'string' && typeof args[0].frameId === 'number'

webNavigation.onErrorOccurred.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].tabId === 'number' && typeof args[0].url === 'string' && typeof args[0].error === 'string' && args[0].error.length > 0

webNavigation.onReferenceFragmentUpdated.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].tabId === 'number' && typeof args[0].url === 'string' && args[0].url.indexOf('#') !== -1

webNavigation.onHistoryStateUpdated.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].tabId === 'number' && typeof args[0].url === 'string' && typeof args[0].transitionType === 'string'

webNavigation.onTabReplaced.why: orbit_web_navigation_event_router.h says so explicitly: Orbit has no prerender or instant-tab swap to report.

windows.onCreated.payload: args.length >= 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0].id === 'number' && typeof args[0].focused === 'boolean'
